column3: Closed tabs stay in the project's one tab order as in-memory placeholders until their toast expires (the life bar ends, or a fourth toast evicts it); undo clears the placeholder flag, and the neighbour lists are deleted
column4: XIN-23 and Bosun: neighbours recorded at close time did not know about earlier closes (close T3, close T4, undo T3, undo T4 gave [T1,T2,T4,T3]). A placeholder keeps its slot whatever order the undos run in
column5: src/lib/tab-order.test.ts, src/state/toasts.test.ts; Chromium: the T3/T4 sequence gives [T1,T2,T3,T4], and after expiry localStorage holds only open tabs
